# Octave Component Library — bundled

> Auto-generated by `build-bundles.sh` — do not hand-edit. Edit the source
> files in `components/` and re-run the script. The canonical component
> library packed into one file so it can be dragged into a Claude project
> (claude.ai takes files, not folders). Excludes `components/_proposed/`
> drafts (not yet canon) to keep this one file small enough to drag into a
> prototyping AI tool.

**26 components.** Each section below is one component's HTML.

---

## settings-cards
_Category: layouts — source: `components/Application Shell/settings/layouts/settings-cards.html`_

```html
<!-- LAYOUT C — CARDS (reference skeleton). Used by: apps.      Responsive 2-col grid of cards (collapses to 1-col under 640px). --><div class="settings-page set-form" data-settings-page="EXAMPLE"><div class="set-container"><header class="set-head"><h1 class="set-head__title">Page title</h1><p class="set-head__desc">One-line description.</p></header><section class="set-section"><div class="set-cards"><!-- repeatable card --><div class="app-card"><span class="app-card__icon"><svg><!-- icon --></svg></span><div class="app-card__body"><div class="app-card__name">Card title</div><div class="app-card__desc">Short description of the item.</div><div class="app-card__foot"><button class="set-btn set-btn--ghost" type="button">Action</button></div></div></div></div></section></div></div>
```

## settings-form
_Category: layouts — source: `components/Application Shell/settings/layouts/settings-form.html`_

```html
<!-- LAYOUT A — FORM (reference skeleton). Used by: preferences, billing.      Page root: .settings-page.set-form > .set-container --><div class="settings-page set-form" data-settings-page="EXAMPLE"><div class="set-container"><header class="set-head"><h1 class="set-head__title">Page title</h1><p class="set-head__desc">One-line description of the page.</p></header><section class="set-section"><h2 class="set-section__title">Section title</h2><!-- a form row = label/desc on the left, a control on the right --><div class="set-row"><div class="set-row__text"><div class="set-row__label">Setting label</div><div class="set-row__desc">Helper text explaining the setting.</div></div><div class="set-row__control"><!-- control: .set-seg | .set-select | .uxt-switch --></div></div></section></div></div>
```

## settings-table
_Category: layouts — source: `components/Application Shell/settings/layouts/settings-table.html`_

```html
<!-- LAYOUT B — TABLE (reference skeleton). Used by: members (and billing's invoices).      Toolbar (search + filter + primary action) → .set-table of rows. --><div class="settings-page set-table" data-settings-page="EXAMPLE"><div class="set-container"><header class="set-head"><h1 class="set-head__title">Page title</h1><p class="set-head__desc">One-line description.</p></header><section class="set-section"><div class="set-toolbar"><span class="set-search"><svg><!-- magnifier --></svg><input type="text" placeholder="Search…"></span><button class="set-btn set-btn--ghost" type="button">Filter</button> <button class="set-btn set-btn--primary" type="button" style="margin-left:auto">Primary action</button></div><div class="set-table"><!-- repeatable row --><div class="member-row"><span class="member-avatar">AB</span> <span class="member-id"><span class="member-name">Row title</span> <span class="member-email">secondary line</span> </span><span class="member-role"><button class="role-badge" type="button">Value</button></span> <button class="member-actions" type="button" aria-label="More"><!-- ⋯ --></button></div></div></section></div></div>
```

```html
<!-- PAGE: agents · layout: HERO (locked) + greyed preview --><div class="settings-page set-form" data-settings-page="agents"><div class="set-container"><header class="set-head"><h1 class="set-head__title">Agents</h1><p class="set-head__desc">Autonomous agents that monitor, triage, and act across your projects.</p></header><!-- Pro-feature hero --><div class="set-hero"><span class="set-hero__icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="10" rx="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2"/><path d="M12 7v4"/><line x1="8" y1="16" x2="8" y2="16"/><line x1="16" y1="16" x2="16" y2="16"/></svg></span><div class="set-hero__text"><span class="set-hero__badge">Pro feature</span><div class="set-hero__title">Unlock Agents</div><div class="set-hero__desc">Deploy autonomous agents to watch your projects and run workflows on your behalf. aria-checked="true"><span class="uxt-switch__thumb"></span></button></div></div><div class="set-card"><div class="set-feature"><span class="notif-row__icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="10"/><line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="4"/><line class="page-title">Banner</h1><p class="page-sub">1:1 port of <code>uxt-react/src/components/Banner/index.tsx</code> (UxtBanner). A docked, full-width notification surface that slides in/out via the <code>isOpen</code> prop. The only props that exist are <code>iconSvg</code>, <code>message</code>, <code>isOpen</code>, <code>actionButton1Text</code> / <code>onActionButton1Click</code> and <code>actionButton2Text</code> / <code>onActionButton2Click</code> — there is <strong>no severity / status / tone enum</strong>. Every color resolves to a real <code>--uxt-theme-palette-*</code> token (surface = background.paper, bottom rule = border.divider, action labels = text.link).</p><!-- Message only (no icon, no actions) --><div class="demo-section-label">Message only — <code>message</code></div><p class="note">With no <code>iconSvg</code> and no action handlers, only the message renders inside <code>content</code>.</p><div class="banner-host"><div class="Banner Banner--opened" data-uxt-component="Banner"><div class="Banner__content"><div class="Banner__message">A new revision of the controlled document set is available.</div></div></div></div><!-- Icon + message --><div class="demo-section-label">Icon + message — <code>iconSvg</code> + <code>message</code></div><p class="note">The leading <code>Icon</code> renders <code>size="large"</code> (24px), only when <code>iconSvg</code> is provided (<code>showIf(iconSvg)</code> in source).</p><div class="banner-host"><div class="Banner Banner--opened" data-uxt-component="Banner"><div class="Banner__content"><span class="Banner__icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M21.94,8.82V18a2,2,0,0,1-2,2H4.06a2,2,0,0,1-2-2V6a2,2,0,0,1,2-2H11.6l1.53,2.84h6.81A2,2,0,0,1,21.94,8.82Z"/></svg></span><div class="Banner__message">6 components in this area need attention before the next IFC release.</div></div></div></div><!-- Single action --><div class="demo-section-label">One action — <code>actionButton1Text</code> + <code>onActionButton1Click</code></div><p class="note">The first text Button always renders; its label is <code>actionButton1Text</code> and color is <code>palette.text.link</code>.</p><div class="banner-host"><div class="Banner Banner--opened" data-uxt-component="Banner"><div class="Banner__content"><span class="Banner__icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12,2A10,10,0,1,0,22,12,10,10,0,0,0,12,2Zm1,15H11V11h2Zm0-8H11V7h2Z"/></svg></span><div class="Banner__message">Aria found 3 anomalies affecting tags in this register.</div></div><div class="Banner__actions"><button type="button" class="Banner__actionButton1">View in register</button></div></div></div><!-- Two actions --><div class="demo-section-label">Two actions — second renders only with <code>onActionButton2Click</code></div><p class="note">The second text Button is gated by <code>showIf(!!onActionButton2Click)</code> in the source — without that handler, only the first action appears.</p><div class="banner-host"><div class="Banner Banner--opened" data-uxt-component="Banner"><div class="Banner__content"><span class="Banner__icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12,2A10,10,0,1,0,22,12,10,10,0,0,0,12,2Zm1,15H11V11h2Zm0-8H11V7h2Z"/></svg></span><div class="Banner__message">Pending design change on the parent line — review the revised P&amp;ID before verifying.</div></div><div class="Banner__actions"><button type="button" class="Banner__actionButton1">Review change</button> <button type="button" class="Banner__actionButton2">Dismiss</button></div></div></div><!-- isOpen = false --><div class="demo-section-label">Closed — <code>isOpen={false}</code></div><p class="note">When <code>isOpen</code> is <code>false</code>, the root carries the <code>closed</code> class: it slides up to <code>translateY(-100%)</code> and ends at <code>display:none</code>, so nothing is visible in the host below.</p><div class="banner-host" style="min-height:1px"><div class="Banner Banner--closed" data-uxt-component="Banner"><div class="Banner__content"><div class="Banner__message">This banner is closed and not visible.</div></div></div></div></body></html>
```
